p.obligations-source: From the findings ledger, verbatim rows:

obligations.fence: | id | from | to | type | |---|---|---|---| | F-NNN | `spec://…#anchor` | `spec://…#anchor` | contradiction | duplication | missing-support | terminology | relocation | reality-mismatch |

facts.RULE-GENRE-FIRST: **Genre first:** name the genre of every document touched; contract wins over lore; normative language never enters design docs.
facts.RULE-ANCHORS-IMMUTABLE: **Anchors are immutable:** a relocated unit leaves a tombstone (`<!-- RETIRED: superseded by #new-anchor -->`); never rename or reuse.
facts.RULE-SINGLE-SOURCE: **Single source:** a duplicated norm survives in exactly one anchor; the other side becomes a citation.
facts.RULE-REALITY-MISMATCH-FLOW: **`reality-mismatch` closes via the sync-from-code flow** — draft the spec diff, surface for owner approval, never apply silently.
facts.RULE-NO-SILENT-REPAIRS: **No silent repairs beyond scope:** discover a problem in a unit not named in §2 → record a NEW obligation in the ledger; do not fix it here. Sprawl of work is forbidden; sprawl of records is mandatory.
facts.RULE-UPDATE-MARKERS: Update the `<status>` markers of every touched unit in the same edit.

facts.ACC-CHECK-GREEN: `vibe progress check` green on all touched files.
facts.ACC-OBLIGATIONS-RESOLVED: Every §2 obligation status = resolved in the ledger, with the resolving edit referenced.
facts.ACC-NO-NEW-CONTRADICTION: No NEW contradiction against the neighbour documents listed here: <list>.
facts.ACC-MARKERS-COMMITS: Markers updated; commit(s) atomic, conventional, no AI attribution.

p.STOP-TWO-WAVES: A conflict that resists two waves (the counter for this doc pair did not fall) is conceptual, not editorial: STOP, set `returned`, escalate to the owner with both readings stated fairly.
